name: Title
reference: A24 trailer title cards: a small serif line in a lot of black, long silences, flash cuts.
pattern: Black ground, white serif type, nothing else.
personality: Restraint. A small line appears without animation and holds in silence.

motion.character: No animation on type: it cuts in and holds. Silence and pacing do the work; flash cuts at the climax.
motion.transitions: Hard cuts, sometimes to black for a beat.

grammar: One small centred line per card.
Black holds between cards are part of the rhythm.
The release line comes last, held.

pictures.note: A dark, desaturated film still; the title sits over it in silence, on its calm part, never across the subject.

footage.note: Slow trailer b-roll between title cards, dark and desaturated.

hits.note: One low impact on the title card, then silence.

compose.how: The dark plate fills the frame (photo with no box); a still too small or too wide to fill a tall frame goes in a letterbox band across the full width (photo `frame: "letterbox"`), never in an inset box with bars round it. The tagline is one small centred line (headline, never display), in the calm band above the subject (the upper third), never across the subject, with wide space round it. It cuts in and holds.

hook.how: A dark plate with the title on frame 0: one small centred line in headline on the plate's calm part. The studio card comes after it, never before.

moves.move: Type cuts in and holds; nothing on the type animates.

measurable.how: Text reaches full opacity in one frame.

moves.move: Black holds between cards are part of the rhythm.

allows.why: Title holds black between its cards: flat black frames between two cards are the rhythm, not an accident.

moves.move: Flash cuts at the climax, accelerating (19, 12, 8, 5, 4 frames of black).

measurable.how: Each flash sits on an onset; the black gaps shrink.

moves.move: One low impact on the title card, then near silence.

measurable.how: The impact stands 6 dB or more over the bed, and the bed stops on it.

props.role: "headline" for the opening card (the hook's role); "display" for the film's title on the reveal card; "body" for the release line; "caption" only for the credits of the studio card

props.frame: "letterbox" for a still that cannot fill the frame

blocks.for: A dark plate behind the type, filling the frame; the flash stills at the climax, a few frames each on the onsets.
The black holds that are the rhythm.

avoid.why: Title changes cards by hard cuts, sometimes to black.

ends.how: The release line comes last in body size, held, over room tone or one low note.
ends.with: the release line in body, centred, held over room tone

mix.note: A low drone and long silences. The bed stops hard on the impact (`music({ until: <the impact> })`); silence holds under the title, or a room tone does (`roomTone: { media, until: <the film's end> }`).

shots.match: One grade for the whole montage: one black point, one white point, one saturation. Each still is shown once.

subjectsToAvoid: Fibonacci numbers or the golden spiral
FizzBuzz or a sort of ten numbers
a horror trailer with a jump scare
